cover: France rocked by violent nationwide protests as cross-border tensions flare worldwide

slides.headline: Over 1,800 Arrested in Violent French Protests
slides.body: Demonstrations over soaring living costs erupted across French cities, leading to chaotic street clashes, arson, and looting. Police detained more than 1,800 people nationwide after deploying riot units. President Emmanuel Macron condemned the unrest, stating there is no place for violence as authorities struggle to restore order.

slides.headline: Deadly Saudi Strikes and Crashes Jolt Yemen
slides.body: A Saudi airstrike killed nine civilians, including five children, in Yemen's Sa'ada province, while a Saudi military helicopter crashed along the border in Najran, killing two crew members. Yemeni forces claimed to have shot down an Apache helicopter as cross-border hostilities sharply escalated.

slides.headline: Deadly Base Fire Sparks Major Canadian Investigation
slides.body: A severe fire and unspecified incident at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta left multiple people dead and several others injured. Emergency responders rushed to the scene to extinguish heavy flames engulfing base facilities. Canadian military officials launched an investigation into the fatal origin of the blaze.

slides.headline: Kolkata Religious Gathering Stampede Leaves 19 Dead
slides.body: A catastrophic crowd surge during a large religious gathering in Kolkata, India, killed at least 19 people and injured dozens more. Emergency responders rushed the wounded to regional hospitals while clearing the packed event grounds, underscoring ongoing crowd safety challenges at massive public festivals.
